description:
Job Title: Full Stack Application Engineer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity 
 Are you passionate about building innovative applications that solve complex mission challenges? CACI is seeking a skilled and motivated Application Engineer to join our team in Laurel, MD. In this role, you will help modernize and enhance critical intelligence systems by developing new applications, automating business processes, and improving how mission information is delivered and consumed.
 Working closely with customers and technical teams, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions that improve operational efficiency, increase situational awareness, and accelerate mission outcomes. This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful work at the forefront of technology while supporting our nation's intelligence community.
  
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain modern applications, software tools, and reusable components that support mission-critical operations.
 Create innovative solutions that automate internal tracking, data collection, and information-sharing processes.
 Analyze requirements and translate them into technical designs, specifications, and implementation plans.
 Develop and support software using industry-standard engineering practices, design methodologies, and development tools.
 Evaluate existing applications and identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
 Estimate development effort, project timelines, and resource requirements.
 Design and implement cloud-native, distributed systems that support high availability and reliability.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize legacy environments and accelerate the delivery of mission information.
 Develop and integrate APIs, databases, and supporting infrastructure to enable secure and efficient data exchange.
 Participate in code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Active TS/SCI w/ Polygraph
 Education & Experience: All education and experience must be in a technical discipline directly related to the position. Degrees, diplomas, and certifications must be earned from accredited institutions. High School Diploma/GED with 12+ years of relevant experience, OR
 Associate's Degree with 10+ years of relevant experience, OR
 Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of relevant experience, OR
 Master's Degree with 6+ years of relevant experience, OR
 Doctorate Degree with 4+ years of relevant experience.
 
 Software Development
 Strong production-level experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
 Experience developing applications using modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue.js, and/or Angular.
 Proficiency with HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Sass/SCSS/Less, and responsive design principles.
 Experience with modern build tools and package managers, including Vite, Webpack, Babel, npm, pnpm, and/or Yarn.
 Experience developing and maintaining unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
 Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and frontend performance optimization techniques.
 System Architecture
 Experience designing and implementing scalable, high-availability, cloud-native distributed systems.
 Strong understanding of API design and integration, including REST, gRPC, and WebSockets.
 Experience implementing caching and content delivery strategies using technologies such as Redis, Memcached, and CDNs.
 Data Management
 Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.
 Experience working with NoSQL and document databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Elasticsearch.
 Cloud & DevOps
 Experience designing and deploying solutions in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.
 Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Kustomize.
  
 Desired: 
 Additional Programming Experience
 Experience with Python, Golang, and/or Java.
 Security, Reliability & Observability
 Experience implementing logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing solutions using tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or the ELK Stack.
 Knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, PKI, mTLS, CORS, and data encryption.
 Experience designing resilient systems using strategies such as rate limiting, circuit breakers, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery planning.
 Engineering Practices
 Advanced proficiency with Git and collaborative development platforms such as GitHub or GitLab.
 Commitment to software engineering best practices, code quality, automated testing, and continuous improvement.
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$103,800 - $218,100 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
